title.to: Amplify deploys only: CI out of Amplify builds, Actions for public repos, LeftBlock receipt gate for private repos

description.to:
Ryan's decisions (2026-10-31):
- Amplify build minutes cost too much. Amplify must ONLY deploy: no lint, type-check or tests inside Amplify builds.
- Public repos: CI runs in GitHub Actions (free minutes).
- Private repos: CI runs locally (Actions minutes are not free). A safeguard still stops a red commit reaching main/production: LeftBlock issues a RECEIPT for a local CI run on an exact commit SHA, published as a GitHub commit status (`leftblock/ci`), and the deploy requires that status. Direction approved by Ryan.
- Standing rules: Gherkin for every behaviour change; a p.apyr.us docs story closes the epic; no arbitrary fixed caps (learn thresholds from data).

## Facts gathered 2026-10-31 (read-only)
- October Amplify spend, Anthus organization: $125. papyrus-production $72.78 ($70.77 = 7,077 build minutes, every app `STANDARD_8GB`, billed $0.01/min). Legacy 335163751677: $50.69, from 5 stale duplicate apps auto-building on every Papyrus / Pilobol.us / TI push; auto-build turned OFF today (≈$50/mo saved already). chatticus-staging $1.53, cyclotron-production $0.32. DataParade organization not checked (SSO expired).
- 30 days in papyrus-production: 542 builds, 74 failed (some retried blindly). Main builds take 10–14 min. Minutes by site: Shipped 1,506; p.apyr.us 1,063; Anth.us 933; Distinctive 873; TI 825; Pilobolus and Data Parade more.
- Amplify apps in papyrus-production (all STANDARD_8GB): anth-us-cms d7s858igkyct5, shipped-cms dkycd9pntgo6d, distinctive-cms d2xke8ygmrzqpp, threat-intelligence-cms d12wnrx15qbcc2, pilobol-us-cms d1eiwl0gedkmnj, p-apyr-us-cms ds6yswxui41yi, dataparade-cms d35q7zv4zad2we, papyrus-web-marketing d2scc0rkxkbrhl, Prospectus d15sc1sptohtqb. Main auto-build ON only for dataparade-cms, papyrus-web-marketing, Prospectus. `staging` branches (BETA) auto-build ON for TI, Pilobol.us, Anth.us, p.apyr.us.
- In flight: `withPapyrus()` (`packages/papyrus/src/with-papyrus.mjs`) skipping Next lint + type-check inside Amplify (type-check OOM'd on TI and Anth.us).
- Branch protection is NOT available on private repos in this org's GitHub plan (API answers 403 "Upgrade to GitHub Pro or make this repository public"). The receipt gate therefore cannot rely on GitHub blocking the merge; it is enforced where the deploy happens (Amplify build verifies the status first, fails in <1 min) plus a LeftBlock pre-push guard. See the gate story and open question 1.
- LeftBlock today (DataParade-io/LeftBlock, public): a Gitleaks-based inspection gate. `install --local --check-only` = pre-commit hook (what every repo here runs); receipt mode = commit-msg hook that appends HMAC-SHA256 trailers (Inspected-by / Inspection-tree / Inspection-result / Inspection-at / Inspection-sig) bound to the tree hash with a shared secret (`LEFTBLOCK_SECRET_PATH`); `verify` checks a commit range; `allow` records reviewed overrides. It has NO notion of running a CI command, NO commit-SHA receipt for a test run, and NO GitHub status posting. Those are new LeftBlock features (stories marked [LeftBlock]).

## Per-repo CI inventory and target
| Repo | Visibility | Amplify app | CI today | Where | Target |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| AnthusAI/Papyrus | PUBLIC | (legacy apps only; amplify.yml in repo is stale) | tests.yml (typecheck, lint, node + pytest + playwright on develop), package-smoke, release | Actions | Actions; keep. Delete or mark the repo-root amplify.yml deploy-only. |
| AnthusAI/Anth.us-web | PUBLIC | anth-us-cms, auto-build off, workflow-started | deploy.yml: tsc, pytest, node --test, then OIDC StartJob | Actions | Actions (already the pattern). Amplify spec deploy-only. |
| AnthusAI/Shipped-web | PUBLIC | shipped-cms, auto-build off | deploy.yml: tsc, unittest, behave; current-main guard | Actions | Actions. Amplify spec deploy-only. |
| AnthusAI/Distinctive-web | PUBLIC | distinctive-cms, auto-build off | deploy.yml: tsc, unittest | Actions | Actions. Amplify spec deploy-only. |
| AnthusAI/p.apyr.us | PUBLIC | p-apyr-us-cms, auto-build off; staging auto-build on | ci.yml + deploy.yml; amplify.yml runs `deploy-backend-if-needed` | Actions | Actions. Amplify spec deploy-only; staging on demand. |
| AnthusAI/Threat-Intelligence | PUBLIC | threat-intelligence-cms, auto-build off; staging on | NO Actions workflow; `npm test` runs INSIDE amplify.yml; typecheck script exists | Amplify | NEW Actions CI (typecheck + npm test + behave) + deploy-on-merge workflow; remove `npm test` from amplify.yml. |
| AnthusAI/Pilobol.us | PUBLIC | pilobol-us-cms, auto-build off; staging on | NO Actions workflow, no test scripts | none | NEW Actions CI (tsc + papyrus-app sync) + deploy-on-merge workflow. |
| AnthusAI/Prospectus | PUBLIC | Prospectus, main auto-build ON | to check | ? | Actions + deploy-on-merge; auto-build off. |
| AnthusAI/DataParade-newsroom | PRIVATE | dataparade-cms, main auto-build ON | unittest in package.json; nothing in Amplify | local (none enforced) | Local CI + LeftBlock receipt; Amplify verifies `leftblock/ci` status before deploying. |
| AnthusAI/Papyrus-web | PRIVATE | papyrus-web-marketing, main auto-build ON | `npm test` INSIDE amplify.yml (plus dnf python install every build, no cache) | Amplify | Local CI + LeftBlock receipt; remove `npm test` from amplify.yml; Amplify verifies status. |
| DataParade-io/LeftBlock | PUBLIC | none | pytest + behave | Actions | unchanged (tool repo for the gate work). |

## Estimated monthly savings (October baseline: papyrus-production 7,077 min = $70.77)
1. Legacy duplicate apps auto-build off (done today): ≈ $50/mo.
2. Checks out of Amplify builds (Next lint + type-check in every `npm run build`; `npm test` in TI and Papyrus-web): ≈ 2–4 min of each 10–14 min build ≈ 25% ≈ 1,700 min ≈ $17/mo.
3. Red commits never reach Amplify (Actions / receipt gate instead of 74 failed builds × ~12 min; no blind retries): ≈ 800 min ≈ $8/mo.
4. Papyrus release fan-out (seven site rebuilds per version bump, ~84 min per release): batch bumps and skip no-op bumps ≈ 1,000–1,500 min ≈ $10–15/mo (measure first; estimate depends on release cadence).
5. Staging branches build on demand instead of every push (4 BETA branches): ≈ 10–20% of builds ≈ $7–14/mo (measure first).
6. Caching (.next/cache + .npm already on for CMS apps; Papyrus-web caches nothing and installs Python with dnf each build): ≈ 1–2 min per build ≈ $5–8/mo.
7. Right-size compute: STANDARD_8GB is billed $0.01/min today; verify in Cost Explorer whether STANDARD differs. Expected $0 unless a cheaper tier exists; faster not cheaper.
Target: papyrus-production ≈ $20–30/mo (from $73); organization ≈ $25–35/mo (from $125).
